Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka.

As per Karnataka State Government order No.LD/300/LET/2006 Bangalore Dated 01.01.2007 and Government Letter No.PW/134/BMS/2007 Dated 27-07-2007, a sum amounting to 1%of the bill amount will be deducted towards Construction Labour Welfare fund.
The Item Rate quoted shall include the Royalty Charges on construction materials and other taxes as per prevailing Government Orders.
Conditional tenders will not be accepted.
The Tenderer shall obtain the required work done certificates from the Competent Authority not below the rank of Executive Engineer or equivalent.
Financial Year will be reckoned as the period between first day of April and Thirty first day of March of succeeding year (both days inclusive).

The Tenderer shall scan Original Ownership Documents/ Lease/ Hire commitment Agreement for the Machineries and attach the scanned file to the Bid. The Original Documents shall be produced at the time of opening of technical Bids for physical verification.
The Employer reserves the right to reject any or all Tenders without assigning any reason or what so ever.
The tenderer shall maintain the Road/Building during the defect liability period.
The Department is not responsible for any delay in accessing KPP-procurement portal.

Financial turnover of previous years shall be given a weightage of 10% per year to bring them to the price level of the 2026-27. And Value at 2026-27 price level, of existing commitments and on-going works to be executed during the next 12 months (Financial commitment of previous years shall be given a weightage of 10% per year to bring them to the price level of the 2026-27) in the Technical Qualification Criteria mentioned in the next section.

Tenderer shall note that the Tenders of those found Eligible as mentioned in Clause 3 - Qualification of the Tenderer in Section 2: Instructions to Tenderers (ITT), will only be considered for evaluation.
The star rates in respect of specified materials (Cement, Steel and Bitumen) shall be payable as per GO No: FD/3/PCL/2008 Bangalore Dated 21.11.2008.

The tenderer shall furnish required information in all formats. Scan and upload all Formats/Original documents required for this bid to the e-procurement portal. The Original Formats/Documents shall be produced at the time of opening of Technical Bid for physical verification.

The proposed methodology and program of construction, backed with equipment planning and deployment, duly supported with broad calculations and quality control procedures proposed to be adopted, justifying their capability of execution and completion of the work as per technical specifications within the stipulated period of completion.
The time stipulated for completion of work is 3 (Three) calendar months including rainy season.
The defect liability period for the work is 12 (Twelve) calendar months.
The Agency shall comply with ISO14001 (Environmental Management System) requirement during execution of work.

To qualify for award of this contract, each Tenderer in his name should have in the last five years i.e., 2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24, 2024-25 and 2025-26 (a) achieved in at least two financial years an annual financial turnover (in all classes of civil engineering construction works only) of Rs.3.50 Lakhs.

To qualify for award of this contract, each Tenderer in his name should have in the last five years i.e., 2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24, 2024-25 and 2025-26 (b) satisfactorily completed as prime contractor, at least one civil work of value not less than Rs.1.10 Lakhs.
At the time of opening of Financial Bids, the Bidders shall furnish all the documents uploaded in original to this office for verification.

The tenderer shall submit an affidavit stating that he has not involved in litigation with Government, also he shall state that, amount of existing / on going works and amount of works awarded to him and yet to be commenced.

The tenderers shall note that as per the Government Order No.FD/850/EXP-12/15 dated 29-12-2015 and GO No.FD/130/EXP-12/15 dated 8-9-2015, the exemption from payment of EMD for Micro and small enterprises registered with NSIC under single point vendor registration scheme is applicable only for supply of goods but not for works.

The tenderer shall note that, the increase in GST shall not be paid in the extended period of contract for which the contractor alone is responsible for delay as determined by the authority while granting the extension of time.
The tenderer shall note that, the GST at 18% shall be paid to the tendered amount separately.

The tenderers shall note that, as per The Karnataka Minor Mineral Concession Rules-1964, it is mandatory to submit the Mineral dispatch Permits (MDPs) issued by a competent authority, along with the bills. If not, penalty will be levied as per the prevailing clauses.

It is mandatory for the contractor to upload the work done certificate issued by an officer not below the rank of Executive Engineer duly indicating the work indent numbers for works costing more than Rs.5.00 lakhs

In accordance with the notification of Government of Karnataka No. DPAL 22 SHASHANA 2016, Bengaluru dated 29.06.2017 and 17.07.2017, as per the Finance Secretariat Notification No. FD 876 Exp-12-2017,Bengaluru dated 15.09.2017 and GO No.DPAL/10/SHASANA/2023 Bengaluru dated 29-3-2023, this work is reserved for SCHEDULED TRIBE AND SCHEDULED CASTE contractors, and only said reserve category contractors shall have to participate in the tender. The reserve category contractors participating in the tender should compulsorily furnish the Caste certificate issued by a competent authority, failing which the tender is liable for rejection.
The scheduled caste/scheduled tribe contractor participating in the tender shall be domicile of State of Karnataka for more than 10 (ten) years.
This work is Reserved for SC category.
Any deviation / error / mistake found in units of items, they should be read as in the unified SR 2023-24 and the rates shall be quoted accordingly.
